description: Canonical schedule for the 6 drift-detection scripts identified by Agent 2. Read by scripts/install-drift-detection-cron.ps1 (Windows Task Scheduler) and by .claude/hooks/drift-alert-surface.mjs (alert reader). Scripts that don't exist on disk are skipped by the installer with a warning — no errors so the manifest can also act as a TODO for missing scripts.

tasks.title: PRISM inventory daily refresh
tasks.rationale: PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md drifts from reality between SessionStart fires (one-per-Claude-session is too sparse for a 24/7 multi-machine setup).

tasks.title: Nightly orphan-engine audit
tasks.rationale: Detect engines without dispatcher wiring; flag for next session.
tasks.missing_note: Source script not yet present on this branch — installer will skip and log.

tasks.title: Hourly inventory delta
tasks.rationale: Alert if inventory drifts >5% in an hour (mass deletion, broken extraction, etc.).
tasks.missing_note: Source script not yet present on this branch — installer will skip and log.

tasks.title: Awareness cache rebuild (debounced)
tasks.rationale: Awareness cache must regenerate after edits, but only every 5min to avoid thrash. Not a Task Scheduler entry — wired via .claude/hooks/.
tasks.missing_note: Source script not yet present; hook integration deferred until the rebuild script lands.

tasks.title: Self-awareness manifest regen on SessionEnd
tasks.rationale: Manifest captures what's reachable per session; regenerate on every Stop hook fire.

tasks.title: Skill trigger population on post-build
tasks.rationale: Skill trigger map drifts when new skills land; runs as a postbuild npm hook.

notes: Tasks with schtasks_args=null are event-triggered, not clock-scheduled. The .ps1 installer only registers tasks where schtasks_args is non-null.
Scripts marked skip_if_missing are skipped with a warning when the source file isn't present — the manifest entry stays as a TODO for the milestone owner.
Removal: schtasks /Delete /TN "PRISM-{id}" /F per task, or run install-drift-detection-cron.ps1 -Uninstall.
